Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: In Step 4, the WebSurfer agent failed to extract the critical information available on the page. The page metadata explicitly listed "rockhopper penguin" in the keywords and the description mentioned "penguins try to climb" and "tenacious penguin". Despite this clear evidence pointing to a Rockhopper penguin, the agent incorrectly concluded that "no official BBC Earth confirmation yet" existed and continued searching for an authoritative source, rather than reporting the definitive lead found in the search results (the MVOTD keywords/description) which was sufficient to identify the species. This failure to utilize existing evidence led to unnecessary further steps and a delay in providing the answer.
